AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#652 @ a22761b5beb593bb463145516b27a09f7f044d58 — VERDICT: APPROVE

This is the first Opus verdict on #652, a full T4 audit. I read the whole own diff against main `ec911328`: 10 files, +777/-75. That covers the migration and its down, the voice repository, service and erasure helper, and every spec. I also read the PR body (tier header T4, accurate), FIX ROUND 1 (5964714320), FIX ROUND 2 (5964932299) and Sol's APPROVE at this head (5965182437).

Counts: A 0, B 0, C 1.

### C-610-10, author-delete half: closed
- `CommunityVoiceRepository.softDeleteWithErasure` (`community-voice.repository.ts:138-155`) does three writes in one `$transaction`: it records the erasure work, then soft-deletes the note (`soft_deleted_at: null` guard, so the first timestamp is kept) and its `voice_note_transcript` search row.
- `deleteAndErase` (`community-voice.service.ts:627-630`) touches storage only after that transaction commits.
- If the erasure attempt fails after the commit, the error is logged and the work is left to `VoiceErasureService`, and the member's delete still answers `deleted` (`:638-657`). That matches the moderation Hide/Ban rule.
- The non-atomic `softDelete` and `softDeleteSearchEntries` are removed, so no caller can split the writes again (tsc is green).
- Account-deletion half: main's #608 finalization already reads the notes, records the erasure work and deletes the search rows inside its single transaction (`account-deletion.service.ts:725-760`), and verifies storage only after the commit (`:834-862`). The two ported specs pass against it.

### C-610-11: closed (migration `20270301000000_community_win_coach_matcher`)
- New `app.community_win_coach_matches(author, coach)`: SECURITY DEFINER with a pinned `search_path`. It returns a boolean, and is TRUE only when the caller is the author or the author's current coach AND the coach is the author's authoritative coach. It never returns an id.
  - EXECUTE: `REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC`, revoked from anon, granted to authenticated and service_role.
- The INSERT policy and the INSERT branch of the SECURITY INVOKER trigger switch to the matcher. Otherwise the policy text is byte-identical to 20270211.
- `REVOKE EXECUTE ... community_win_author_coach FROM authenticated` actually closes the lookup: 20270211 had already revoked PUBLIC (`:125`), so no PUBLIC grant is left behind.
- The only other caller, `community_win_teammate_visible`, is SECURITY DEFINER (`20270211:129-134`), so SELECT for authenticated keeps working. The existing win RLS live cases stay green.
- `down.sql` restores the 20270211 grant, policy and trigger body exactly, then drops the matcher.
- Failing-before: tests-only commit `9a0412bc` is red in community-live-tests ([job 111081132330](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37080955113/job/111081132330)) and build-and-test ([job 111081132286](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37080955113/job/111081132286)). Both are green at this head.

### C-610-12: closed
`recordVoiceErasures` (`voice-erasure.ts:102-108`) runs a conditional `updateMany` on `completed_at IS NOT NULL`. A completed row re-opens with `attempts 0`, `last_error null`, a new `reason`, and due now. Open work keeps its count. It runs inside the caller's transaction, so it is atomic with the soft delete. Tests: the `community-ugc-b5.spec.ts` C-610-12 block, which includes a guard that open work is not reset.

`63dbc59a` and `fb33823f` are pure. `01603a0f` (#608) takes main's side of the three account-deletion files, and `a22761b5` only adds the ported tests. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main(ec911328) a22761b5` = head tree `5cf3d026`, so nothing on main is changed or lost.

### C: optional
- **C-652-1: shared migration prefix.**
  - The folder `20270301000000_community_win_coach_matcher` shares its timestamp with #647's `20270301000000_notification_zone_provenance_reminder_generation` and the annex.
  - `_COMMON_115` reserves `20270301000000` for #647 ("own folder") and the annex, and does not list #652.
  - Prisma keys on the full folder name and the two migrations are independent, so nothing collides. Both sort after every applied prefix.
  - Operator: confirm (my default), or rename to a free prefix before merge.

### Evidence
- CI at `a22761b5`: all 11 required checks pass, including community-live-tests and rls-live-tests running the C-610-11 live cases. The merge state is CLEAN.
- Method: I read the code at the exact head. I ran no local suites (CI is green, and the CI runs at `9a0412bc` show the new tests failing before the fix). Nothing was pushed.
